title: Blender materials and light
line: Real-looking surfaces, textures and light for your renders.

project.title: A bottle on a wooden table
project.brief: Model a simple bottle and a table on your own. Make the bottle glass, put a wood image on the table, light the scene and render it in Cycles with a soft background.
checks: A glass material and an image-textured material are both assigned
The camera has depth of field on with a focus object set
A Cycles render is saved as a PNG

lessons.title: Metal, plastic and rubber
lessons.goal: Teach Blender's Principled BSDF in depth. Make three spheres, one shiny plastic, one brushed metal and one dull rubber, using only Base Color, Metallic and Roughness.
lessons.passes: Three spheres have three materials and exactly one has Metallic at 1.

lessons.title: Glass and glowing things
lessons.goal: Teach transmission, IOR and emission on Blender's Principled BSDF by making a glass ball with an IOR of 1.52 and a small bulb that glows.
lessons.passes: One material has full transmission and IOR 1.52, and one has emission above 0.

lessons.title: Build a material from nodes
lessons.goal: Teach Blender's Shader Editor by wiring a Noise Texture through a Color Ramp into the Base Color of a Principled BSDF to make a marble ball.
lessons.passes: A Noise Texture feeds a Color Ramp that feeds the material's Base Color.

lessons.title: Unwrap a crate
lessons.goal: Teach UV unwrapping in Blender. Mark seams on a cube-shaped crate in Edit mode, unwrap it and arrange the islands in the UV Editor so none overlap.
lessons.passes: The crate has marked seams and a UV map whose islands do not overlap.

lessons.title: Put an image texture on it
lessons.goal: Teach Image Texture nodes in Blender by putting a wood image on the unwrapped crate through Base Color and adding a roughness map set to Non-Color.
lessons.passes: An Image Texture feeds Base Color and the roughness image is set to Non-Color.

lessons.title: Light the scene with an HDRI
lessons.goal: Teach world lighting in Blender by loading an HDRI into an Environment Texture node on the World and setting its strength so it lights the crate on its own.
lessons.passes: The World uses an Environment Texture node with an HDR or EXR image loaded.

lessons.title: Three-point lighting
lessons.goal: Teach three-point lighting in Blender by placing area lights named Key, Fill and Rim around the crate, with the key at least twice as strong as the fill.
lessons.passes: Area lights named Key, Fill and Rim exist and Key has at least twice Fill's power.

lessons.title: Depth of field
lessons.goal: Teach camera depth of field in Blender. Turn it on, set the focus object to the crate and lower the F-Stop to 2.8 so the background goes soft.
lessons.passes: The camera has depth of field on, the crate as focus object and F-Stop 2.8.

lessons.title: Cycles and Eevee settings
lessons.goal: Teach the difference between Cycles and Eevee in Blender by rendering the crate in both, with Cycles at 128 samples and denoising on, and saving the two images.
lessons.passes: Two PNG renders are saved, one from Cycles at 128 samples and one from Eevee.
